entries.title: Proverbs 9:1
segments: ¶Wisdom hath built her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars;

entries.title: Proverbs 9:2
segments: she hath slaughtered her cattle, she hath mingled her wine, she hath also prepared her table;

entries.title: Proverbs 9:3
segments: she hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the summits of the high places of the city,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:4
segments: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither. To him that is void of understanding, she saith,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:5
segments: Come, eat ye of my bread, and drink of the wine that I have mingled.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:6
segments: Forsake follies and live, and go in the way of intelligence.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:7
segments: He that instructeth a scorner getteth to himself shame; and he that reproveth a wicked [man] [getteth] to himself a blot.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:8
segments: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee; reprove a wise [man], and he will love thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:9
segments: Impart to a wise [man], and he will become yet wiser; teach a righteous [man], and he will increase learning.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:10
segments: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; and the knowledge of the Holy is intelligence.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:11
segments: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and years of life shall be added to thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:12
segments: If thou art wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself; and if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:13
segments: ¶The foolish woman is clamorous; she is stupid, and knoweth nothing.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:14
segments: And she sitteth at the entry of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:15
segments: to call passers-by who go right on their ways:

entries.title: Proverbs 9:16
segments: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither. And to him that is void of understanding she saith,

entries.title: Proverbs 9:17
segments: Stolen waters are sweet, and the bread of secrecy is pleasant.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:18
segments: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; [that] her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
